'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Greg Shaw LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Greg Shaw]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]

* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-greg-shaw-ls-hidden-base-mains/ PC list]
